purpose: Freeze the exact empirical genetic response and inferential surface that may be opened only after a complete PASS of the dataset-specific fresh Phase-3 Gate-D qualification.

sequence_contract.valid_sequence_pair: columns where both aligned sequences are canonical >= ceil(0.50 * frozen alignment length)

locality_contract.locality_identity: exact frozen Phase-2 locality index and coordinate; no reclustering or coordinate rounding
locality_contract.locality_pair_distance: arithmetic mean of uncorrected p-distance over all valid cross-locality sequence pairs for the frozen edge endpoints
locality_contract.sequence_pair_weighting: equal weight per valid cross-locality sequence pair

primary_estimand.name: place_beyond_ibd
primary_estimand.test: frozen out-of-species profiled-private TTF using the exact Phase-3 private reference families and the inherited Phase-2 train/eval split
primary_estimand.positive: profiled_private_p_value <= 0.05 with finite scores for every frozen evaluation species
primary_estimand.negative_interpretation: lineage-conditioned spatial structure only if the separately qualified within-species self-detectability diagnostic is positive; otherwise NOT_EVALUABLE

secondary_descriptive_estimand.name: total_genetic_distance_transfer
secondary_descriptive_estimand.claim_limit: Do not use the raw-distance transfer surface to override or rescue the primary post-IBD confirmatory decision.

forbidden: removing high-divergence sequences after identity opening
choosing minimum rather than mean locality-pair distance
changing the Phase-2 graph, species panel, or train/eval split
regenerating Phase-3 private references with a favorable random seed
changing bandwidth, alpha, IBD residualization, or profiled-private configuration count
calling a failed or incomplete empirical analysis evidence of absence
